basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow (Computer Science and Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur is hiring 2 Senior Research Fellows (SRF) for the project "Automation and Setting Up of a Reference Lab for Validating Cryptographic Algorithms/Modules as per ISO/IEC Standards" (Project Code R/RVI), sponsored by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India. The assignment is for 13 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier, with consolidated compensation of up to Rs. 42,000 per month depending on qualification and experience. content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow (SRF) - Research at a Glance

rows.details: Automation and Setting Up of a Reference Lab for Validating Cryptographic Algorithms/Modules as per ISO/IEC Standards (Project Code – R/RVI)
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (Government of India)
13 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Up to Rs. 42,000 per month (consolidated, depending on qualification and experience)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through a process described in any one of the following, with two years of research experience: Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. Selection through national level examinations conducted by Central Government departments and their agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. M.Tech./M.E./M.S. from a reputed institute/university in Computer Science and Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, with CGPA at least 8.50 or marks at least 80%. OR B.Tech./B.E./M.Sc./MCA from a reputed institute/university in the same fields, with a valid GATE Score and CGPA at least 8.50 or marks at least 80%; AND two years of research experience. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 42,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The assignment is temporary, and its tenure is 13 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow (SRF) - Research
content_sections.text: Applications are invited online, and the last date of application is 11 December 2026. The notice does not describe the online portal or the form-filling steps. The notice lists the application fee as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates. The notice says the application fee shall be deposited through RTGS/NEFT/net banking etc. to the State Bank of India account (bank code 00202), account name IIT SRIC-OM Account, account number 39502115210, IFSC code SBIN0000202, SWIFT code SBININBB339. The bank address given is P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the application form.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Research Fellow posts has IIT Kharagpur announced?
faq.answer: IIT Kharagpur has announced 2 Senior Research Fellow (SRF) - Research posts in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering. The notice gives no category-wise break-up.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Kharagpur SRF recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 11 December 2026. Applications are invited online.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Kharagpur SRF post?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET or GATE or a national level examination named in the notice, with two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Kharagpur SRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 32 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 42,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.answer: The notice lists the fee as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the SRF assignment at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: The tenure is 13 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. It is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project.

faq.answer: The sponsoring agency is the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India. The project is Automation and Setting Up of a Reference Lab for Validating Cryptographic Algorithms/Modules as per ISO/IEC Standards.
